definitions.gloss: fully loaded, packed full, brimming with
definitions.explanation: Loaded to full capacity with cargo or goods. Also used figuratively to mean packed with content, features, or information.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満載|まんさい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The truck was fully loaded with cargo.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{満載|まんさい}だ。
examples.english: This magazine is packed with useful information.

examples.japanese: お⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧{満載|まんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}→今週末：30306_konshuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: An event packed with fun activities will be held this weekend.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (fully loaded with physical cargo) and the figurative meaning (packed with content) are both very common. The figurative usage is especially frequent in advertising and promotional writing: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{満載|まんさい} (packed with information), ⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧{満載|まんさい} (loaded with perks).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{満載|まんさい}: packed with information
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{満載|まんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to load to full capacity
- お⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧{満載|まんさい}: packed with fun
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧{満載|まんさい}: full of charm/appeal
